text:
Maya Chen: Heads up — I'm seeing revenue schedule numbers off for a handful of EUR invoices from yesterday. Looks like FX feed returned stale rate during the 02:00–03:30 UTC window. Can we triage before close? :warning:

Thomas Li: thanks for flagging. do you have sample invoice ids and the rates we pulled?

Maya Chen: sample: INV-2026-0427, INV-2026-0431. Billing export shows EUR->USD rate used = 1.1210 but market rate should've been ~1.0850. That materially changes recognized USD revenue and deferral split.

BillingBot: automated alert: FX feed outage detected at 2026-05-01T02:12Z; provider=Xignite; fallback_rate_used=true; exchanged_pairs=[EURUSD]; impacted_records=134

Anya Patel: ugh. which ledger runs used that feed? close run or recognition job?

Thomas Li: recognition job run id: revrun-20260501-08. It uses rates cached from feed at job start. If cache had stale value, then schedules generated are wrong.

Zach Rivera: can we reproduce fast? I can run a targeted SQL to list affected invoices. Try this:```sql
SELECT invoice_id, currency, amount_local, fx_rate, amount_usd
FROM billing.invoice_lines
WHERE currency = 'EUR' AND invoice_ts BETWEEN '2026-05-01' AND '2026-05-02' AND fx_source = 'xignite_cache';
```

Emma Park: if the USD recognized amount is wrong we should pause final posting for those invoice ids. Who owns the GL re-run? Accounting needs an approval to re-run recognition schedules.

Maya Chen: I pulled a small sample. INV-2026-0427: amount_local=5000 EUR, fx_rate=1.1210 -> amount_usd=5605.00 (posted). Correct fx_rate=1.0850 -> amount_usd=5425.00. Delta = -180.00 USD (decrease).

Anya Patel: delta sign matters for deferrals. Looks like we'll need to adjust deferred revenue and recognize the corrected amounts. Could be both journal reversals and re-posts.

Thomas Li: engineering note: the cache invalidation didn't trigger because the provider returned 200 with stale payload. I've opened infra ticket INF-734. I can push a hotfix to make the recognition job re-fetch on non-newer timestamps.

Zach Rivera: operational plan suggestion: 1) run targeted query to enumerate affected invoices 2) mark them for manual hold in AR system 3) re-run recognition job with corrected FX snapshot 4) post adjustment journals 5) notify customers if invoice totals change > $1000 6) include in month-end memo

Maya Chen: agree. I'll start the enumeration and produce CSV for accounting. ETA 30m.

Emma Park: please include invoice date, original_fx, correct_fx, posted_usd, corrected_usd, delta_usd, and suggested journal entries columns. I'll queue review with controller after we have CSV.

Anya Patel: also add a column 'impact_on_deferred' with boolean if deferral bucket changes. helps prioritize.

BillingBot: run report complete: affected_count=134; high_impact_count=9 (delta_abs > 1000); report_url=https://redwood.internal/reports/fx-impact/1767001234.csv

Maya Chen: uploaded CSV to the path Zach requested and annotated the top 20. Sharing short sample rows:INV-2026-0427,5000,1.1210,1.0850,5605.00,5425.00,-180.00,false

Thomas Li: Engineering will block automatic recognition job re-runs until we have a confirmed remediation plan. I'll add a short-lived kill-switch on the scheduler.

Emma Park: controller sign-off required to delay close on those invoices — I can escalate. If impact is limited (134 invoices, 9 high impact) we can do targeted adjustments and proceed with close. If any customers are scheduled for ARR audits, escalate to legal.

Maya Chen: next steps doc: - Maya/Zach: finalize affected list (done) - Anya/Emma: draft adjustment journal entries and approval package - Thomas: deploy scheduler guard and patch feed check - Finance ops: rerun recognition job with corrected FX snapshot once approved - Ops: communicate to CS if invoice totals change > $1000

Zach Rivera: I've kicked off the corrected-snapshot dry run on staging to validate journal diffs. No write to prod. Will post diff csv in 20m. :eyes:

Anya Patel: thanks. can we keep a changelog entry for month-end so auditors can see why manual adjustments applied? include ticket refs and feed provider logs.

Maya Chen: yes — I'll create a month-end memo draft and attach the CSV + INF-734 + revrun id.

Emma Park: once we have the adjustment totals, I'll prepare the journal entries for approval. For now don't post any reversal entries in GL.

Thomas Li: ETA for dequeue and patch: 2 hours. Will update thread.

Maya Chen: thanks everyone. tagging @controller for visibility. :white_check_mark:
